acceptanceCriteria: A dispatch-time check (corvint-tasks or a corvint command) reports, for each candidate ticket, whether an open PR, a merged PR or an origin/main commit already references it as delivered
Dispatched lanes hold a Tasks claim or reservation that a second dispatch sees and refuses
PR body convention distinguishes delivered tickets from mentioned ones, and the check honours it
Measured on the next sweep: duplicate or already-delivered assignments below 10% of dispatched tickets
body: Observed 2026-10-21 in orchestrated 1.0 sweep lanes. proc-1021c delivered 1 of 7 assigned tickets, scopes-1021c 1 of 8, and lanes built 3 duplicates of work already in open PRs (affected-1021d rebuilt V1-2053, already in #1421, then reverted it). Causes: (1) dispatch takes no Tasks claim, so nothing shows a ticket is in flight; (2) tickets stay OPEN after their PR merges (see closeout-lag ticket); (3) PR bodies use 'Refs V1-X' for tickets the lane did not deliver, so a text search cannot tell delivered from mentioned. Interim mitigation: a scratch screen script that checks open/merged PR bodies and origin/main commits for strong refs, and a charter rule that 'Refs' is used only for delivered tickets. Version: corvint-tasks local build from origin/main (2026-10-21).
